notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks 1.0 Launches on Steam
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that [b]our publisher Wired Productions and developer Caged Element have officially launched Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks on Steam today.[/b] Following an early access phase that saw over 250,000 players blast opponents, this high-octane combat racing game has had some tuning up and has sped into 1.0. 

Last week, Wired Productions revealed they had taken over publishing rights – [b]removing microtransactions entirely [/b]- and introducing fresh tracks, maps, game modes, and customization options. Assemble your crew of Grotz, Gitz, and Squigz – and battle in PVP and PVE lobbies! 

Visit the Warhammer site for more details and stay tuned for insights into the game's next explosive chapter, as Wired Productions continues its partnership with Caged Element, the original publisher of 2018’s acclaimed GRIP: Combat Racing. Embrace the chaos, ignite the battles, and experience the thrill of Speed Freeks like never before.

Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks is available now on Steam at a special discounted price of just $15.99, €15.99 and £12.79.  

[b]New content includes:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Player-hosted games: Create private or public lobbies with custom settings.  
[*] New Vehicle – Trukk: A havoc-wreaking ambush vehicle with a fearsome amount of firepower and rowdy orks in the back.  
[*] New Game Mode - Free Roam: Choose any map and create custom races around it, as well as practice driving skills and abilities.  
[*] New Maps: Da Dust Up and Da Gorge are Speed Freeks’ most dynamic and visually striking to date.  
[*] Ork Pit Bosses: Players can now unlock and customize Ork avatars to show off to teammates and enemies alike.  
[*] Alternative Weapons: Unlockable weapons expand the playstyles of each vehicle for new ways to master them.  
[/list]

notes.title: Beneath Reveals Terrifying Trailer for Lovecraftian Days Fest
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that [b][url=https://wiredproductions.com/games/beneath/]Beneath[/url][/b], the heart-pounding FPS from Wired Productions and Portuguese indie studio Camel 101, has been selected to showcase its spine-chilling content at [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/LovecraftianDays2025]Lovecraftian Days Fest from April 14 to 21[/url][/b]!

To celebrate this exciting event, we’ve released a skin-crawling new trailer that reveals the eldritch horrors lurking in the depths of this survival horror adventure.

Check out the new trailer here:

[previewyoutube=oOcA27_j4qc;full][/previewyoutube]

But that’s not all! We’re also inviting you to sign up for our closed monthly playtest, which begins on May 15. This is a unique opportunity for you to get an early hands-on experience with [b]Beneath[/b] and contribute to shaping the future of this monstrous indie gem.

Don’t miss your chance to get involved — [url=https://mailchi.mp/wiredproductions/omniumtrials][b]SIGN UP HERE[/b][/url]

Following the success of the psychological thriller [b][url=https://wiredproductions.com/games/those-who-remain/]Those Who Remain[/url][/b] in 2019, [b][url=https://wiredproductions.com/games/beneath/]Beneath[/url][/b] represents a renewed collaboration between Wired Productions and Camel 101.

Drawing inspiration from iconic games like F.E.A.R., Resident Evil, and Half-Life, [b][url=https://wiredproductions.com/games/beneath/]Beneath[/url][/b] promises to deliver a gripping blend of action, psychological tension, and immersive storytelling that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Additionally, don't forget to check out Wired Productions’ [url=https://wiredproductions.com/games/karma-the-dark-world/]KARMA: The Dark World[/url], which is also featured in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/LovecraftianDays2025][b]Lovecraftian Days Fest[/b][/url] and has been met with incredible acclaim since its release last month.

notes.title: The action and the horror in Beneath
notes.content:
Creating an action-horror game is all about finding that delicate balance between keeping players on the edge of their seat and giving them just enough power to fight back.

In a game like Beneath, the goal is to make the player feel both vulnerable and capable at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/d554c2288b8de28058a778fdc07c80b357d14c31.jpg[/img]

It starts with pacing. Think of it like a rollercoaster—you don’t want non-stop action or constant terror, or else the player gets numb to it.
Instead, we try to alternate between intense, heart-pounding combat sequences and slower, creeping moments of suspense.

It’s in those quieter moments that the fear really sinks in because the player doesn’t know when the next threat will hit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/4843e7b47d9ae27e6bb90a8c4a830cc64d81b336.jpg[/img]

Another big part of maintaining that balance is resource management.
In action-heavy games, players can feel unstoppable if they have endless ammo and health. But in a horror game, we want them to feel like every bullet counts, like every enemy encounter could be their last.

It’s that sense of scarcity and uncertainty that makes combat moments even more intense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/186939fbe929bdc7d7b2b49dfd96ff9e4828c580.jpg[/img]

Enemy design is where action and horror come together.

On one hand, the enemies need to be challenging to fight, but on the other hand, they should evoke fear.
The best kind of enemies are the ones that make the player hesitate, that make them question if they’re ready to engage or if they should run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/b483d571ba8036fd721fd3cff4193731b228783e.jpg[/img]

The atmosphere plays a huge role too. Even when the action ramps up, we want the world to still feel oppressive and unsettling. Through lighting, sound, and environmental details, we aim to create a space where the player never feels truly safe, even in the heat of combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/2a096ad793b1079a5bdcd6eec1e565c60c48254e.jpg[/img]

In the end, it’s all about balance. The player should feel like they’re walking a fine line between survival and disaster.

There’s a satisfaction in overcoming tough enemies, but we want the player to always feel a little on edge, knowing that the world around them is constantly trying to tip that balance back toward fear.

notes.title: Development blog - The enemy soldiers
notes.content:
During his journey, Quinn will face a number of different threats. Some can be avoided, others evaded, but for some, he'll need to rely on his weapons.
The most common enemy Quinn will face are the Omnium security forces. These private military contractors are highly trained and well-armed.

While their exact mission is unclear, they usually shoot on sight. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/eefb462534252256d599f1d6ce0f7f5f89155e04.jpg[/img]

Often, Quinn can sneak past them or eavesdrop on their conversations to gather valuable intelligence, but at other times, they may be lying in wait, ready to storm a room and attempt to corner him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/9f6bc72451f7f96834beeb9368ae0c193f12db35.jpg[/img]

In narrow corridors, cover is scarce, making gunfights particularly dangerous.

However, in larger areas, the enemies will use whatever cover is available and may try to outflank Quinn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/a86eac40e4975d9886f47e2b02f953e1a461543c.jpg[/img]

When confronting a group of soldiers, taking cover is essential, but it's equally important to keep moving, as they are equipped with grenades.

Study your surroundings, plan your attack and keep moving!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/c91909c2d500faa73d30ce2ae0ba2fbcc3bdf423.jpg[/img]

If you're being pursued by a large group, use the environment to your advantage. Shooting explosive materials can take down several enemies, and if they haven't spotted you yet, taking out the lights will force them to rely on their flashlights, reducing their visibility.
It might give you the edge you need to ambush the enemy patrol.

When you encounter a group of soldiers, decide whether you need to engage. 
If you do, make sure to plan your attack carefully before taking action.

notes.title: Development blog - The atmospheric diving suit
notes.content:
Throughout his adventure, Quinn will sometimes be forced to venture outside into the cold depths of the ocean. The underwater bases are located very deep, which means he can’t simply equip a wetsuit and swim around. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/6548b79d57910b9eb941923eb80a05457cdd204c.jpg[/img]

Luckily for him, the bases are equipped with atmospheric diving suits that Quinn can use when he needs to leave their supposedly safe confines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/ce91398709edc1f6ccc4e9bd41e692676f1cb628.jpg[/img]

An atmospheric diving suit (ADS) is a specialized, articulated suit designed to allow a diver to operate safely at great depths underwater while remaining at atmospheric pressure. This means that the pressure inside the suit remains the same as it is at the surface, regardless of the external water pressure.

The suit is not equipped with weapons, but it does have flares that can be used to scare away curious creatures

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/7025103b0c735de62f16f09fa28e88b01f908758.jpg[/img]

The most pressing danger, though, is oxygen—or the lack of it. There are oxygen stations spread around the area that can be used to refill the tank, but you’ll need to be mindful of where you’re going.
If you venture too far, you might not make it back to an oxygen station in time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/110de25fd5bec88ff5e457d805ea714637e83bdf.jpg[/img]

And don’t forget to pay attention to your surroundings. You never know what might be around the corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/de41db0ade3bc6b6438e03a81355168bf654b744.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Development Blog - Weapons, workbench and upgrades
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/36a2a0fea714a6985550cf30ec1a05ed1e1221cf.jpg[/img]
Quinn's underwater adventure throws a mix of challenges his way. Some require cunning wit, but others demand a more direct approach: blunt force.

Luckily for Quinn, there are a lot of weapons in the complex of underwater stations where the action unfolds. While some guns maybe be rare and difficult to locate, even the standard-issue gear of fallen foes can bolster your arsenal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/17a4df868402840504a4077e338ae0f8b6b94529.jpg[/img]
You can upgrade your weapons at workbenches strategically positioned in key locations. 
By collecting sufficient weapon parts scattered throughout the stations, you can create upgrades to improve their effectiveness. It's not necessary to craft upgrades for each individual weapon; instead, upgrades apply to entire weapon classes. For instance, crafting a high-capacity magazine for assault rifles grants the upgrade to all three assault rifles featured in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/61ffe0c0015958696e3e16aad9c3e1c0abedb57f.jpg[/img]
Although this is definitely a great help for Quinn, the use of workbenches extends beyond weapon upgrades. Coating kits, scattered throughout the stations, offer another avenue for enhancement. These kits allow you to unlock various weapon coatings, enabling you to select the one that best aligns with your preferred style.

notes.title: Development Blog - Environments & locations
notes.content:
As Quinn (the main character) plunges deeper, the familiar world recedes, replaced by a network of claustrophobic underwater outposts. Each base carries its own story etched into its very structure. 
The metallic tang of fear hangs heavy in the air of a pressure-riddled haven, cracks snaking across the bulkheads. 
In another base, flickering emergency lights cast an eerie dance on grimy walls, a constant reminder of the power teetering on the brink. 
These aren't just backdrops; they're immersive experiences that not only paint a picture, but also influence the way Quinn navigates these desperate outposts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/d9a15ecdf6c5661ebfe12a11dc819326b957e026.jpg[/img]The half-submerged storage room is a graveyard of forgotten equipment. The stillness is broken only by the rhythmic drip, drip, drip of leaking water. But wait... a ripple disturbs the surface, a fleeting movement just beyond the reach of the wan light. Maybe there's something in the water?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/35a2ee7fdd54644b7caa9f9ebc36da32acc236b2.jpg[/img]The flickering fluorescent lights cast long, skeletal shadows across the desolate concrete corridor. Abandoned equipment and half-eaten rations litter the floor – silent testaments to a hasty evacuation. But did you just hear footsteps?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/56e7040eb07d7bcb14f6aee2b0f0fe9610f727ed.jpg[/img]A tendril of unnatural mist snakes across the floor, swirling and clinging to the metallic grates like a spectral shroud. The air hangs thick and heavy, carrying a metallic tang that stings the nostrils.  Did a sinister gas leak from within the base, or is this a chilling harbinger of something lurking outside its cold, steel walls?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/4630c2d77acd8bca36a45b14d275bda9e9161092.jpg[/img]A grotesque tableau unfolds before you – mangled limbs hang from rusted hooks, the metallic tang of blood heavy in the air. A chilling silence hangs like a shroud, broken only by the faint, echoing screams that seem to originate from the depths of the base. What horrors await those who venture further?

Each location whispers a tale of survival etched into its very walls. Deciphering these stories, the clues scattered amongst debris and decay, will be your key to navigating this treacherous world.  Remember, charging in guns blazing often leads to a dead end. Sometimes, the greatest weapon is a sharp mind and a discerning eye.

Stay tuned for further updates and be sure to add it to your wishlist if you haven't already :)

notes.title: Development Blog - Destructible environment
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we're going to talk a bit about combat and destruction.
Our aim is to elevate the combat experience to the highest level of realism and excitement. This involves integrating elements such as authentic sound, realistic weapon interactions, recoil, and impactful bullet impacts. We are firm believers that an engaging combat scenario requires the dynamic presence of particles and objects in motion, responding dynamically to each shot. In our showcase, we'll be offering a sneak peek of what you can anticipate in terms of physics and the immersive interaction between the game world and the bullets.

Almost every lamp in Beneath is susceptible to gunfire, allowing players to shoot and extinguish them:

[previewyoutube=NbvEGdLac-k;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=3CUT1hbtVXQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=bQxaSo35jB0;full][/previewyoutube]

Bullets cause deformation in metallic surfaces upon impact:

[previewyoutube=dhI62g1LUG8;full][/previewyoutube]

Monitors, glass, mirrors, and select tables are all breakable:

[previewyoutube=TIbTs5_kMHo;full][/previewyoutube]

Some sections of cement walls will break as well:

[previewyoutube=HioYYybE6QA;full][/previewyoutube]

Paper files and documents will also be sent flying:

[previewyoutube=8b5VPIjoupk;full][/previewyoutube]

Fire extinguishers and specific barrel types (of course) will detonate upon impact. And there's a lot more. We want you to have fun breaking stuff down!

Stay tuned for more updates 🎮🌟

notes.title: Development Blog - Behind the scenes
notes.content:
Hey there, everyone! Ready for a sneak peek into what's been going on behind the scenes in the development of Beneath? We've been diving deep into the creative process, working hard to craft scenes and environments that will plunge you into a mysterious and thrilling world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/2bca2cfec93f20ca32b4d31da47fc6c4ce581ecb.jpg[/img]

Creating these environments goes way beyond just making things look cool – it's about making you feel like you're really there. The team has poured their hearts into crafting scenes that tell their own stories. Whether it's the peaceful calm of an observatory or a seriously spooky infested hallway, each place is designed to draw you right into its unique vibe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/fc871e63ee66b6dc42cc950cfed12c53c5dfd5c8.jpg[/img]

Making these places interactive and lifelike also requires some technical work. Our team has been busy developing systems that make the environments come alive. From dynamic effects that shift the mood of a scene to intricate physics simulations that enhance realism, every single detail adds up to make the whole experience totally immersive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/bba6b4103820342a261716b50bcee45bc5c83a34.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates – we can't wait to share more of Beneath with you all! 🎮🌟

notes.title: Beneath
notes.content:
It's with great excitement that we present to you our latest game, which has been in the works for the past two years. 
After taking you to the far reaches of space and immersing you in the spine-tingling atmosphere of a haunted town, we are now embarking on a new adventure that will submerge you into the depths of the ocean.
Join us on this thrilling journey, battling shady soldiers and enigmatic creatures, while keeping a firm grip on your sanity. Welcome to BENEATH.

[i]"Deep beneath the surface, an ancient terror awakens, and the creatures that dwell in the deep begin to stir.
Will you survive the horrors that await you in the depths?"[/i]

Check out the announcement trailer and add Beneath to your wishlist!
